packages.label: Samsung Free
packages.reason: The swipe-left feed of news, offers and sponsored content (once Samsung Daily).

packages.label: AppCloud
packages.reason: ironSource's AppCloud. Pushes sponsored app installs; no Samsung feature uses it.

packages.label: AppCloud (older name)
packages.reason: The same sponsored-installs service under its older package name.

packages.label: Mobile Services Manager (Digital Turbine)
packages.reason: Digital Turbine's installer that adds sponsored apps and games.

packages.label: Visit In
packages.reason: Location-triggered offers when you are near partner shops.

packages.label: Galaxy Widget
packages.reason: A widget that promotes Samsung and partner services.

packages.label: Tips
packages.reason: The Tips app and its notifications.

packages.label: Customization Service
packages.reason: Profiles how you use the phone for personalised content and ads. Some smart suggestions stop.

packages.label: Recommended apps agent
packages.reason: Installs Samsung's 'recommended apps' after setup and some updates.

packages.label: Install app
packages.reason: Installs the recommended-app bundle chosen for your region.

packages.label: Game Launcher
packages.reason: Game hub with recommended games and ads. Your games still run; the hub and its shortcut go.

packages.label: Dynamic Lock Screen
packages.reason: Downloads rotating lock-screen pictures. Some lock-screen wallpaper options need it.

packages.label: Bixby Voice
packages.reason: Bixby's voice assistant. Set the side key to the power menu if it opens Bixby.
